snippet.title: Cinder and Crowns — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
⚔️ Build Your Kingdom, Conquer the Realm

Your kingdom is under threat. Will you rise as a ruler who commands armies, forges alliances, and claims the throne — or watch your empire crumble?

In Cinder and Crowns, build a thriving medieval kingdom from the ground up, train powerful armies, and lead epic battles against rival lords for control of the realm. Recruit legendary heroes, form alliances with players worldwide, and outsmart your enemies with cunning strategy.

🏰 Build & upgrade your castle and city
⚔️ Train and command massive armies
🤝 Join alliances and dominate together
👑 Takeover rival kingdoms for glory and territory
🔥 Real-time strategy where every decision shapes your fate

The war for the throne has begun. Will you lead your kingdom to victory?

👉 Visit our website to learn more: https://cnc.skyvanillagames.com

Coming Soon on iOS & Android
